scope: Numerical portability re-execution of the exposed-data budget benchmark; same statistical methods, data, objectives, bounds and selection policy
primary_metric: track-weighted mean of four binary Brier scores
failure_rule: Per-label identity fallback for single-class calibration or explicit optimizer nonconvergence; report every fallback. Programming errors, corruption or nonfinite inputs abort. No redraws.
interpretation: Paired descriptive sensitivity across 20 overlapping historical splits, not 20 independent datasets or a fresh holdout; one nested budget draw per split. No application update.
